title: Private schema-23 sample review against the Known Limitations

input.kind: privately supplied, independently produced ETS6 .knxproj (project namespace 23)
input.privacy: No name, id, address, count, digest or vendor identity of the input is recorded in the repository; private census output stays in an ignored local directory.

private_gate.result_without_variable: exit 101, panics with 'SKIP is not a pass' (refusal, not a pass)
private_gate.private_mutant: object number + 1 in the device-local branch: exit 101 at the device-local assertion; file restored byte-identical
private_gate.assertions: boolean only: every device program resolves uniquely; every object id matches one production rule; every device-local and every module object id names a ComObjectRef with the same ComObject/@Number; every Links token names a group address; presence of Node-style and root-style trees, an address-less device, a repeated module RefId and a RepeatIndex counter above one

public_checks.clippy: cargo clippy -p knx-etsproj --test private_schema23_refids -- -D warnings: exit 0

product_corpus_measurement.scope: OriginalData/ProductDatabases (local, not redistributable), 114 archives, 525 unique application-program files by content hash

not_claimed: whole-project import of the private sample (separate import-integrity work)
ETS round trip, signature verification or ETS parity
KNX Secure, hardware or download support for any device
semantics of RepeatIndex counters, stored loaded images, little-endian or UTF-8 parameter encoding
